+# Cursor conversion design
+
+**Date:** 2026-09-23
+**Status:** Approved scope (thin adapter, then finish the started H1/H4/D1 data path). Not yet executed.
+**Review:** [Cursor conversion review](file:///C:/Users/zhenq/.cursor/projects/d-Software-Development-thetradingbotofcc-forex/canvases/cursor-conversion-review.canvas.tsx)
+
+## Goal
+
+Make this repo a trustworthy Cursor workspace for the next strategy, without rewriting the trading spine and without replacing the unimplemented Claude agent runtimes.
+
+## What is already true
+
+- `CLAUDE.md` is the canonical invariant brief. Cursor already injects it every session. Strategy files and specs cite it by that name. It stays.
+- The deterministic spine (`src/engine`, `src/risk`, `src/backtest`, `src/execution`) is ordinary Python. A new strategy is still: pure `Strategy`, unit tests, `scripts/run_backtest.py --strategy Name --walkforward`.
+- `CoworkScheduledRuntime` and `ClaudeAgentSDKRuntime` in `src/agents/runtime.py` both raise `NotImplementedError`. They are not on the path that practices a strategy. They stay unimplemented.
+- Tier-1 export/backtest plumbing is already written in the working tree and is not committed: `src/data/timeframes.py`, `tests/data/test_timeframes.py`, `scripts/mt5_export.py`, `scripts/run_backtest.py`.
+
+## What is not true, and will mislead the next session
+
+- `AGENTS.md` is a 14 Jun 2026 claude-mem dump about git lock files. Cursor applies it as a standing rule.
+- `README.md` and `docs/specs/README.md` still say no code has been committed.
+- `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md` stops at 3 Jun 2026.
+- `py` on this machine is Python 3.14.3. The project requires 3.12 (VPS has no x86-64-v2; `numpy<2`). CPython 3.12.13 is installed via uv and has no pytest and no project venv.
+- There is no `.cursor/rules/` directory.
+- `CLAUDE.md` tells agents to repair a Linux mount-flush quirk with a shell heredoc. That does not apply on this Windows host.
+
+## Approach
+
+Three options were considered.
+
+1. **Thin adapter, then finish the started data path.** Recommended and approved. Cursor rules plus a 3.12 pin plus status-doc headers, then commit the timeframe work that is already in the tree. The spine and the agent-runtime seam do not change.
+2. Full instruction rewrite. Rejected. It would churn dozens of `CLAUDE.md` citations and would not make a strategy testable.
+3. Replace Cowork / Claude Agent SDK with a Cursor automation. Rejected for this pass. It delays strategy practice and builds a scheduler that was never implemented.
+
+## Design
+
+### Instruction surface
+
+| File | Role |
+|---|---|
+| `CLAUDE.md` | Canonical invariants, gates, playbook. Stays. Drop the Linux heredoc from the always-on gotchas, or mark it as a remote-mount-only note. Add the `--symbol` / `--timeframe` commands once that code is committed. |
+| `.cursor/rules/host.mdc` | Always on. PowerShell. Use the 3.12 venv, never bare `py`. Do not commit `.env` or `state/`. |
+| `.cursor/rules/strategy-playbook.mdc` | Always on. Short form of the new-strategy playbook and the fill-realism rule, pointing at `CLAUDE.md` for the full text. |
+| `AGENTS.md` | Replace the mem dump with a ten-line pointer at `CLAUDE.md`, the two rules, and `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md`. The rules remain the source of truth if a memory plugin rewrites `AGENTS.md`. |
+
+Rules stay under the Cursor guidance: one concern, short, actionable. No new strategy content.
+
+### Interpreter
+
+- `.python-version` contains `3.12`.
+- A gitignored `.venv` is created from the uv CPython 3.12.13 install.
+- Dev extra from `pyproject.toml` is installed into that venv.
+- `pytest` is run with `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q`.
+- Bare `py` (3.14) is not the project interpreter.
+
+### Status the agent will read
+
+Update only the opening status lines of:
+
+- `README.md`
+- `docs/specs/README.md`
+- `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md`
+
+The new status says: the spine is built; SessionBreakoutER has no live-placeable edge (`docs/RESTING_STOP_FIX.md`); the EURUSD M15 OHLCV search is exhausted as of mid-July 2026; `docs/FRAMEWORK_REVIEW_2026-07-15.md` is a proposal and is not approved; a new strategy still has to clear the R6 gates, walk-forward, and lockbox.
+
+Do not rewrite the historical research library.
+
+### Data-path slice (already started)
+
+Finish means: the path rules are pure and unit-tested, the scripts call those functions, pytest is green, and the slice is committed. It does not mean pulling new bars. MT5 export still runs only on the Windows host with the FTMO terminal open, and never from a US geolocation.
+
+Path rules, matching the code already in the working tree:
+
+- Default export with no `--symbol` and timeframe M15 keeps `backtest.data_path` (`state/parquet/eurusd_m15.parquet`).
+- Any other symbol or timeframe writes `state/parquet/{symbol}_{tf}.parquet`, both lower-cased.
+- Supported labels: `M15` (15), `H1` (60), `H4` (240), `D1` (1440). Anything else raises `ValueError`.
+- `scripts/run_backtest.py --data` wins. Otherwise `--symbol` or `--timeframe` selects the canonical parquet and marks the run as DEV (nothing written to the config store). `timeframe_minutes` is set from the label so ATR and session logic see the real bar size.
+- Pip size for a non-default symbol comes from MT5 `symbol_info` inside the exporter only. That function is not unit-tested here because it needs the terminal.
+
+The 200→100 `min_trades` default in `src/backtest/gates.py`, and the matching note already edited into `CLAUDE.md`, record a decision dated 2026-06-30. They are committed with this cleanup so the tree is not left half-applied. They are not a Framework Review change. Tasks A–D in that review stay unapproved and uncommitted.
+
+### Commits this design allows
+
+1. Cursor host pin, rules, `AGENTS.md`, status headers.
+2. Timeframe helpers, exporter, backtest data path, tests, `docs/DATA_EXPANSION_PLAN.md`.
+3. The already-approved 100-trade floor (`gates.py` + the `CLAUDE.md` note).
+4. The staged `2026-07-08` triage (the index already links it and the file is not in HEAD) plus the untracked 2026-07-16 and 2026-07-17 triages and their index rows.
+
+Not in these commits: `docs/FRAMEWORK_REVIEW_2026-07-15.md`, the untracked promotion briefs, any strategy module, any promotion.
+
+### Stop line
+
+Conversion is done when:
+
+- `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` passes on Python 3.12.
+- A session sees the host rule and a status doc that matches the repo.
+- The data-path slice is committed.
+- No file under `src/engine/strategy_*.py` was edited for a new idea.
+
+The actual H1/H4/D1 parquet pull is a later host task. It needs the FTMO terminal. It is not part of this stop line.
+
+## Out of scope
+
+- Framework Review tasks A–D (family-scoped DSR, ledger backfill, CI lockbox, noise-aware fold gates).
+- Multi-instrument harness (Data Expansion Plan Tier 3).
+- FRED macro features (Tier 2).
+- Implementing `CoworkScheduledRuntime` or `ClaudeAgentSDKRuntime`.
+- Any new strategy.

+then a later bar whose high trades above that lower high.
+Bearish is the mirror: a higher swing low, then a higher swing high, then a
+later bar whose low trades below that higher low.
+
+After the 15m trigger closes, a 5m fair-value gap may arm a limit:
+buy limit at the top of a bullish gap, sell limit at the bottom of a bearish gap.
+Stop is beyond the far side of the gap by the 5m ATR(14).
+A newer same-side gap at a better price (higher buy, lower sell) replaces the
+resting limit. Risk is a fixed dollar amount, sized from the stop distance.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Bar:
+    ts: datetime
+    open: float
+    high: float
+    low: float
+    close: float
+    spread: float = 0.0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Swing:
+    index: int
+    kind: str  # "high" | "low"
+    price: float
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Choch:
+    side: str  # "buy" | "sell"
+    level: float
+    confirm_index: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Fvg:
+    side: str
+    top: float
+    bottom: float
+    index: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Trade:
+    side: str
+    entry_time: datetime
+    exit_time: datetime
+    entry: float
+    stop: float
+    target: float
+    exit: float
+    lots: float
+    net_usd: float
+    r_multiple: float
+    reason: str
+
+
+def swings(bars: list[Bar], wing: int = 2) -> list[Swing]:
+    """Fractal swings. A swing at i is confirmed only once bar i+wing has closed."""
+    found: list[Swing] = []
+    if wing < 1:
+        return found
+    for i in range(wing, len(bars) - wing):
+        hi = bars[i].high
+        lo = bars[i].low
+        left_right = range(1, wing + 1)
+        if all(hi > bars[i - k].high and hi > bars[i + k].high for k in left_right):
+            found.append(Swing(i, "high", hi))
+        if all(lo < bars[i - k].low and lo < bars[i + k].low for k in left_right):
+            found.append(Swing(i, "low", lo))
+    return found
+
+
+def choch_events(bars: list[Bar], wing: int = 2) -> list[Choch]:
+    """15m change-of-character events, confirmed at the break bar (no lookahead)."""
+    events: list[Choch] = []
+    highs: list[Swing] = []
+    lows: list[Swing] = []
+    used_buy: int | None = None
+    used_sell: int | None = None
+    pending = [s for s in swings(bars, wing)]
+    cursor = 0
+    for i in range(len(bars)):
+        while cursor < len(pending) and pending[cursor].index + wing <= i:
+            sw = pending[cursor]
+            cursor += 1
+            if sw.kind == "high":
+                highs.append(sw)
+            else:
+                lows.append(sw)
+        if len(highs) >= 2 and len(lows) >= 2:
+            prev_h, last_h = highs[-2], highs[-1]
+            prev_l, last_l = lows[-2], lows[-1]
+            if (last_h.price < prev_h.price and last_l.price < prev_l.price
+                    and last_l.index > last_h.index and i > last_l.index
+                    and bars[i].high > last_h.price and used_buy != last_h.index):
+                events.append(Choch("buy", last_h.price, i))
+                used_buy = last_h.index
+            if (last_l.price > prev_l.price and last_h.price > prev_h.price
+                    and last_h.index > last_l.index and i > last_h.index
+                    and bars[i].low < last_l.price and used_sell != last_l.index):
+                events.append(Choch("sell", last_l.price, i))
+                used_sell = last_l.index
+    return events
+
+
+def fair_value_gap(bars: list[Bar], index: int) -> Fvg | None:
+    """3-candle gap ending at `index`. None when the gap is missing or degenerate."""
+    if index < 2:
+        return None
+    first, third = bars[index - 2], bars[index]
+    if third.low > first.high:
+        return Fvg("buy", top=third.low, bottom=first.high, index=index)
+    if third.high < first.low:
+        return Fvg("sell", top=first.low, bottom=third.high, index=index)
+    return None
+
+
+def atr_series(bars: list[Bar], window: int = 14) -> list[float]:
+    """Wilder ATR at each bar. Early bars are 0 until `window` true ranges exist."""
+    out = [0.0] * len(bars)
+    if window <= 0 or len(bars) <= window:
+        return out
+    trs = [0.0]
+    for i in range(1, len(bars)):
+        prev = bars[i - 1].close
+        tr = max(bars[i].high - bars[i].low,
+                 abs(bars[i].high - prev),
+                 abs(bars[i].low - prev))
+        trs.append(tr if math.isfinite(tr) else 0.0)
+    value = sum(trs[1:window + 1]) / window
+    out[window] = value if math.isfinite(value) else 0.0
+    for i in range(window + 1, len(bars)):
+        value = (value * (window - 1) + trs[i]) / window
+        out[i] = value if math.isfinite(value) else 0.0
+    return out
+
+
+def atr(bars: list[Bar], index: int, window: int = 14) -> float:
+    """Wilder ATR in price units, using only bars up through `index`."""
+    if index < 0 or index >= len(bars):
+        return 0.0
+    return atr_series(bars[:index + 1], window)[-1] if bars else 0.0
+
+
+def lots_for_risk(risk_usd: float, entry: float, stop: float, contract: float,
+                  lot_step: float, min_lot: float) -> float:
+    """Round down so a stop-out loses at most about `risk_usd` before spread."""
+    distance = abs(entry - stop)
+    if distance <= 0 or contract <= 0 or lot_step <= 0 or risk_usd <= 0:
+        return 0.0
+    raw = risk_usd / (distance * contract)
+    steps = math.floor((raw / lot_step) + 1e-9)
+    lots = steps * lot_step
+    if lots + 1e-12 < min_lot:
+        return 0.0
+    return round(lots, 8)
+
+
+def _floor_minutes(ts: datetime, minutes: int) -> datetime:
+    minute = (ts.minute // minutes) * minutes
+    return ts.replace(minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
+
+
+def aggregate(bars: list[Bar], minutes: int) -> list[Bar]:
+    """Build higher-timeframe bars from lower-timeframe opens. Incomplete groups are kept."""
+    if not bars:
+        return []
+    groups: list[list[Bar]] = []
+    current: list[Bar] = []
+    bucket = _floor_minutes(bars[0].ts, minutes)
+    for bar in bars:
+        key = _floor_minutes(bar.ts, minutes)
+        if key != bucket and current:
+            groups.append(current)
+            current = []
+            bucket = key
+        current.append(bar)
+    if current:
+        groups.append(current)
+    out: list[Bar] = []
+    for group in groups:
+        out.append(Bar(
+            ts=group[0].ts,
+            open=group[0].open,
+            high=max(b.high for b in group),
+            low=min(b.low for b in group),
+            close=group[-1].close,
+            spread=group[-1].spread,
+        ))
+    return out
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Order:
+    side: str
+    limit: float
+    stop: float
+    target: float
+    lots: float
+    spread: float
+    armed_index: int
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Position:
+    side: str
+    entry_time: datetime
+    entry: float
+    stop: float
+    target: float
+    lots: float
+    spread: float
+
+
+def _net(side: str, entry: float, exit_: float, lots: float, contract: float,
+         spread: float) -> float:
+    direction = 1.0 if side == "buy" else -1.0
+    gross = (exit_ - entry) * direction * contract * lots
+    return gross - (spread * contract * lots)
+
+
+def simulate(
+    m5: list[Bar],
+    *,
+    risk_usd: float = 25.0,
+    reward_r: float = 2.0,
+    contract: float = 100.0,
+    lot_step: float = 0.01,
+    min_lot: float = 0.01,
+    wing: int = 2,
+    atr_window: int = 14,
+    buffer_price: float | None = None,
+) -> list[Trade]:
+    """Walk 5m bars. 15m structure is aggregated from those same bars.
+
+    A limit is armed on the close of the gap bar and can fill only later.
+    On the fill bar, only the stop is eligible (the bar's favorable extreme
+    is assumed to have printed before the retrace). Later bars: stop first
+    if both stop and target are inside the bar.
+    """
+    if reward_r <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("reward_r must be positive")
+    m15 = aggregate(m5, 15)
+    events = choch_events(m15, wing)
+    # Map each 15m break onto the last 5m bar that belongs to that 15m bucket.
+    m15_close_m5: dict[int, int] = {}
+    for index, bar in enumerate(m5):
+        m15_close_m5[_floor_minutes(bar.ts, 15)] = index
+    choch_at: dict[int, Choch] = {}
+    for event in events:
+        higher = m15[event.confirm_index]
+        m5_index = m15_close_m5.get(_floor_minutes(higher.ts, 15))
+        if m5_index is not None:
+            choch_at[m5_index] = event
+
+    trades: list[Trade] = []
+    active: Choch | None = None
+    order: _Order | None = None
+    position: _Position | None = None
+    atrs = atr_series(m5, atr_window)
+
+    for i, bar in enumerate(m5):
+        event = choch_at.get(i)
+        if event is not None:
+            if position is None and order is not None and order.side != event.side:
+                order = None
+            active = event
+
+        if position is not None:
+            hit = _exit_on_bar(position, bar, contract, risk_usd)
+            if hit is not None:
+                trades.append(hit)
+                position = None
+            continue
+
+        if order is not None and i > order.armed_index:
+            filled = _try_fill(order, bar, contract, risk_usd)
+            if isinstance(filled, Trade):
+                trades.append(filled)
+                order = None
+            elif isinstance(filled, _Position):
+                position = filled
+                order = None
+
+        if position is not None or active is None:
+            continue
+        if i < atr_window:
+            continue
+        gap = fair_value_gap(m5, i)
+        if gap is None or gap.side != active.side:
+            continue
+        if buffer_price is not None:
+            buffer = buffer_price
+        else:
+            buffer = atrs[i]
+        if buffer <= 0:
+            continue
+        if gap.side == "buy":
+            limit = gap.top
+            stop = gap.bottom - buffer
+            if not stop < limit:
+                continue
+            target = limit + reward_r * (limit - stop)
+            better = order is None or limit > order.limit
+        else:
+            limit = gap.bottom
+            stop = gap.top + buffer
+            if not stop > limit:
+                continue
+            target = limit - reward_r * (stop - limit)
+            better = order is None or limit < order.limit
+        if not better:
+            continue
+        sized = lots_for_risk(risk_usd, limit, stop, contract, lot_step, min_lot)
+        if sized <= 0:
+            continue
+        order = _Order(gap.side, limit, stop, target, sized, bar.spread, i)
+
+    return trades
+
+
+def _exit_on_bar(position: _Position, bar: Bar, contract: float, risk_usd: float) -> Trade | None:
+    if position.side == "buy":
+        if bar.low <= position.stop:
+            return _close(position, bar, position.stop, contract, risk_usd, "stop")
+        if bar.high >= position.target:
+            return _close(position, bar, position.target, contract, risk_usd, "target")
+    else:
+        if bar.high >= position.stop:
+            return _close(position, bar, position.stop, contract, risk_usd, "stop")
+        if bar.low <= position.target:
+            return _close(position, bar, position.target, contract, risk_usd, "target")
+    return None
+
+
+def _try_fill(order: _Order, bar: Bar, contract: float, risk_usd: float) -> Trade | _Position | None:
+    """Return a closed trade when the fill bar also hits the stop, else an open position."""
+    if order.side == "buy" and bar.low <= order.limit:
+        if bar.low <= order.stop:
+            pos = _Position(order.side, bar.ts, order.limit, order.stop, order.target,
+                            order.lots, order.spread)
+            return _close(pos, bar, order.stop, contract, risk_usd, "stop")
+        return _Position(order.side, bar.ts, order.limit, order.stop, order.target,
+                         order.lots, order.spread)
+    if order.side == "sell" and bar.high >= order.limit:
+        if bar.high >= order.stop:
+            pos = _Position(order.side, bar.ts, order.limit, order.stop, order.target,
+                            order.lots, order.spread)
+            return _close(pos, bar, order.stop, contract, risk_usd, "stop")
+        return _Position(order.side, bar.ts, order.limit, order.stop, order.target,
+                         order.lots, order.spread)
+    return None
+
+
+def _close(position: _Position, bar: Bar, exit_: float, contract: float,
+           risk_usd: float, reason: str) -> Trade:
+    net = _net(position.side, position.entry, exit_, position.lots, contract, position.spread)
+    r_mult = net / risk_usd if risk_usd else 0.0
+    return Trade(
+        side=position.side,
+        entry_time=position.entry_time,
+        exit_time=bar.ts,
+        entry=position.entry,
+        stop=position.stop,
+        target=position.target,
+        exit=exit_,
+        lots=position.lots,
+        net_usd=net,
+        r_multiple=r_mult,
+        reason=reason,
+    )
+
+

+    push(128, 124)
+    push(136, 130)
+    # price does not trade back to 130

+    push(200, 160)

+    push(110, 108)
+    push(112, 100)   # bearish-ish, not a higher buy gap
+    push(129, 120)   # trades to 120, fills 130? low 120 <= 130, yes fills first limit
+    push(200, 150)
+    return bars
